messages:
Naomi Park: Quick internal roll-call for Solstice Health onboarding. Need owners for kickoff, enablement, and renewal-watch. Can we do a 20min dry run tomorrow 9:00am PT?
Arjun Desai: 9:00 works for me. Ill take the technical walkthrough (auth, webhooks, retry logic).
Mel Carter: I can own enablement + success criteria. Proposed 30-day success: 1) staging app authenticates and calls API; 2) 4 validated prompts with quality >= 0.8; 3) health dashboard with basic alerts; 4) at least 1 pilot workflow executing daily.
Naomi Park: Key customer contacts: Priya Verma (PM) - primary, Daniel Ho (Data Eng) - integration lead, Sara Liu (Security). Internal owners: Naomi (CS Lead), Arjun (SE), Mel (Enablement).
Arjun Desai: Timeline suggestion: Day 0: creds & test org; Day 1-5: integration + schema mapping; Day 6-12: validation & perf tuning; Day 13-28: pilot; Day 29-30: handoff + retro. If they request private VPC add a security review window (+5 business days).
Mel Carter: Renewal risk: flag "high" if no pilot traffic by day 30 or if security review blocks production path. I'll add a renewal column to the healthboard with mitigation steps.
Naomi Park: Can someone ask the customer for expected QPS and embedding volumes pre-kickoff? That will determine whether we suggest Dedicated or tweak batching.
Arjun Desai: I'll send the Qs in the pre-read. Note on embeddings: if they plan to index >200k vectors upfront, recommend incremental ingest and a short Dedicated trial for indexing throughput.
Mel Carter: I'll prepare the enablement deck (25min) + 10min dev quickstart. Will include a short code snippet for the SDK and a 3-step webhook example.
support-bot: Created event "Solstice Health  Internal Dry Run" for 2026-04-12 09:00 PT. Guests: Naomi Park, Arjun Desai, Mel Carter.
Naomi Park: Action items: Arjun - perf checklist + infra notes; Mel - enablement deck + prompts + survey; Naomi - customer invite + agenda + pre-read. Please add 4 example prompts to the shared doc before the dry run.
Mel Carter: I'll draft a 3-question post-demo survey: 1) Ease of integration (1-5), 2) Prompt quality satisfaction (1-5), 3) Biggest blocker to production.
Arjun Desai: Quick dev snippet for the quickstart I'll add to the repo:
```python
# minimal sync request
import requests
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'model':'rwd-standard','prompt':'Summarize patient note'})
print(resp.status_code, resp.json())
```
Naomi Park: Great. If no objections I'll run the dry run and then invite Priya/Daniel/Sara after. :thumbsup:
Mel Carter: :thumbsup:
Arjun Desai: See you tomorrow.
Naomi Park: Closing this prep thread; will post customer invite and rehearsal notes after the run.
